fields.name: asset_id
fields.definition: Stable provider/security identifier; ticker mapping versioned

fields.name: date
fields.definition: Exchange trading date, not naive UTC calendar date

fields.name: session_id
fields.definition: Regular, overnight or combined; never mix implicitly

fields.name: RV
fields.definition: Variance in squared decimal returns per stated interval; not annualized unless flag says so

fields.name: sampling_minutes
fields.definition: Required for simple RV; robust measure gets its own method field

fields.name: RQ
fields.definition: Record whether M/3 sum r^4 or another convention

fields.name: M
fields.definition: Actual sampling increment count; early-close days handled

fields.name: robust_measure
fields.definition: Kernel/preaveraged variance with implementation metadata

fields.name: measure_method
fields.definition: Estimator, bandwidth and boundary convention

fields.name: return_decimal
fields.definition: Return interval and total-return convention must match policy

fields.name: overnight_return
fields.definition: Close-to-open return with adjustment convention

fields.name: cash_return
fields.definition: Cash return for the holding interval; source and availability lag

fields.name: borrowing_rate
fields.definition: Required for leverage above one

fields.name: timestamp
fields.definition: Original precision and timezone retained

fields.name: price
fields.definition: Trade or quote-side price; corporate action handling recorded

fields.name: bid
fields.definition: Quote filters and crossed/locked status documented

fields.name: ask
fields.definition: Quote filters and crossed/locked status documented

fields.name: size
fields.definition: Units and aggregation rule

fields.name: condition_code
fields.definition: Document admissible trade/quote conditions

fields.name: missing_fraction
fields.definition: Grid points not supported by usable observations

fields.name: stale_gap_seconds
fields.definition: Maximum time since last usable observation

fields.name: calendar_version
fields.definition: Exchange calendar, DST and early-close rules

fields.name: adjustment_convention
fields.definition: Splits, distributions and return construction

fields.name: source_version
fields.definition: Provider snapshot/version and retrieval date

fields.name: source_sha256
fields.definition: Hash of unchanged source bytes

fields.name: quality_flags
fields.definition: Missing/outlier/halt/early-close/exclusion flags

fields.name: information_available_at
fields.definition: When feature/measure could actually be used

fields.name: target_start
fields.definition: First date in h-day target

fields.name: target_end
fields.definition: Final date; must have matured before fitting labels
